WI-10 (UC-009) — GET /api/v1/admin/analytics (SuperAdminOnly, cross-tenant) + WeeklyDigestJob (RunTickAsync-shell, idempotent per fleet+ISO week).

== ENDPOINT: GET /api/v1/admin/analytics ==

Endpoint class: GetPlatformAnalyticsEndpoint (EndpointWithoutRequest<GetPlatformAnalyticsResponse>).
Policy: SuperAdminOnly. DontCatchExceptions() applied. Uses existing AdminFeatureConfiguration.

Per-fleet SQL aggregates (each query uses raw fleet_id WHERE clause, no tenant filter needed at query level):
- MonthAggRow: rides, revenue_czk, active_drivers, active_customers, last_order_at (this month Prague)
- MonthRidesRow: rides, revenue_czk (last month Prague)
- SparklineRow: week_start (date_trunc 'week'), rides (12-week window)
- SMS count via db.NotificationLog.IgnoreQueryFilters().CountAsync(Channel == NotificationChannel.Sms)
- NullableDateRow: MAX(created_at) for fleets with no orders this month

Health flag logic: inactive check first (lastOrderAt null OR < now-14d), then growing(MoM>=+10%), declining(MoM<=-10%), stable.
MoM delta: 0→N = +100%; both 0 = 0%; N→0 = -100%; else standard %.

Sparkline key fix (critical bug found and fixed): The SQL returns date_trunc('week', ... AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague')::date — a Postgres calendar date, read by EF/Npgsql as DateTime at 00:00 (Prague-local midnight). The original cursor was ToUtc(pragueMonday).DateTime which is UTC midnight = 22:00 the prior day in Prague summer time. These never compared equal, producing all-zeros. Fix: BuildSparkline now takes a DateOnly sparklineStartMonday (Prague-local) and keys the dict on DateOnly.FromDateTime(r.WeekStart). Both sides are now pure calendar dates.

Platform totals: fleet count, sum rides/revenue this month, growing/declining/inactive counts.

Cross-tenant guards: IgnoreQueryFilters() on Fleets query (line comment documents intent); IgnoreQueryFilters() on NotificationLog and PushSubscriptions queries.

== JOB: WeeklyDigestJob ==

BackgroundService with PeriodicTimer(5 min, timeProvider). RunTickAsync:
1. Gate: DayOfWeek == Monday AND Hour >= 6 (Prague local) — else log Debug and return.
2. Last ISO week: computed from (Monday - 1 day = Sunday of last week) using ISOWeek.GetWeekOfYear.
3. Scan: all active fleet IDs via IgnoreQueryFilters on Fleets.
4. Per-fleet isolated scope (poisoned change-tracker isolation pattern from WI-14):
   a. Set CurrentTenant.FleetId for the scope.
   b. Check WeeklyDigestMarker for (IsoYear, IsoWeek) → skip if exists (idempotency).
   c. Aggregate week + prior week via SqlQuery<WeekAggRow>.
   d. Skip if both weeks have 0 rides.
   e. Top driver first name via JOIN query (only first name returned — no full PII).
   f. Czech push text assembled (rides, revenue, delta%, avg rating, top driver name).
   g. FleetAdmin users' PushSubscriptions fetched (AsNoTracking + IgnoreQueryFilters on PushSubscriptions).
   h. Per-recipient try/catch: Gone/Failed logged, remaining recipients continue.
   i. WeeklyDigestMarker written ONCE regardless of send outcomes.
5. Per-fleet try/catch: logs fleet id + reason, does not abort other fleets.

Registered in JobsServiceExtensions.AddJobs().

== ROUND-2 FIXES (impl-reviewer findings F1–F4) ==

F1 (MEDIUM) — GetPlatformAnalyticsEndpoint.cs: SmsEstimatedCostCzk was hardcoded smsCount × 1. Fixed to read SmsUnitCostCzk from FleetSettings using IgnoreQueryFilters() (cross-tenant endpoint, no fleet_id claim) and the (int?) cast pattern to avoid the 0-default trap. Formula is now smsCount * smsUnitCost (default 1 when no FleetSettings row). New test GetAdminAnalytics_SmsCost_UsesPerFleetSmsUnitCostCzk validates the fix.

F2 (MINOR) — WeeklyDigestJob.cs: Added AsNoTracking() to both the Users read query (~lines 175-180) and the PushSubscriptions read query (~lines 189-192). These are read-only for sends; the WeeklyDigestMarker insert is unaffected.

F3 (MINOR) — WeeklyDigestJob.cs: Removed 'WeeklyDigestJob' class-name prefix from all 6 log message templates per rules/logging.md (SourceContext carries the class name). Updated templates: 'Tick failed', 'Skipped', 'Fleet failed', 'Skipped' (marker+zero variants), 'Push failed', 'Digest sent'.

F4 (INFO) — GetCustomersEndpoint.cs: Parameterized the AnonymizedPhone sentinel in the new-vs-returning FormattableStringFactory call. Changed '{AnonymizedPhone}' inline string to {3} placeholder and passed AnonymizedPhone as the 4th argument to FormattableStringFactory.Create. Consistent with all other queries in the file.

== DESIGN DECISIONS ==

- Health flag: inactive takes precedence over MoM bands (checked first). MoM 0→N = +100% (classified as growing). Both 0 = 0% (stable if not inactive).
- Last order timestamp for inactivity: uses MAX(created_at) from the this-month aggregate; falls back to a second query (MAX across all time) only when no orders this month. This avoids loading all orders.
- Sparkline cursor: DateOnly Prague-local Mondays for both cursor and dict key. SparklineRow.WeekStart (EF DateTime from Postgres ::date) is converted via DateOnly.FromDateTime. This avoids UTC-offset mismatches (Prague UTC+2 means ToUtc(monday).DateTime is 22:00 of Sunday, not 00:00 of Monday).
- WeeklyDigestJob AggregateWeekAsync uses SqlQuery directly (no IgnoreQueryFilters needed since the SQL uses explicit fleet_id WHERE clause — not the EF query filter).
- SmsUnitCostCzk: IgnoreQueryFilters() required because GetPlatformAnalyticsEndpoint has no fleet_id JWT claim (SuperAdmin context, CurrentTenant.FleetId = null) so the FleetSettings tenant query filter would match nothing and always return null → 0-default trap. The (int?) cast in Select prevents the int.FirstOrDefault()=0 trap.
